$comment: NB 2.1 art spec for the Coin Cosmetics Boutique playmats. Paint with: node art/wavespeed.mjs boutique-playmat --backend gemini --image-size 2K
lead: Paint a wide landscape tabletop playmat seen from directly overhead.
style: Top-down atmospheric tabletop playmat illustration in oil and gouache: calm, low-contrast centre field so playing cards placed on top stay crisp and legible, richest ornamental detail pushed subtly toward the outer edges, matte cloth weave texture, muted controlled values.
rules: Keep the central 65% calm, evenly lit and uncluttered so tabletop cards remain easy to read. No text, letters, numbers, borders, logos or card outlines anywhere.

items.subject: an overhead view of deep royal emerald velvet table cloth with subtle antique gold corner filigree and dark shadowed mahogany table grain along the outer border
a calm midnight-indigo star-chart tapestry with delicate pale gold astronomical arcs and brass compass corners framing a quiet dark-blue centre
dark matte volcanic slate surface with subtle glowing ember veins only along the far perimeter and calm charcoal-grey stone across the middle
tranquil deep sea-teal water seen from straight above, faint sunlit caustics and quiet coral silhouettes near the edges
serene dark jade garden pond seen from above, floating lily pads and a few pale lotus blossoms resting gently near the corners, calm mirrored water in the centre
warm seasoned tavern oak wood planks seen from directly above, subtle brass inlay corners and soft candlelight warmth across quiet wood grain
